user.title: Connect e-Calendar
user.description: Enter the ESP MAC address. Uses the MQTT integration already configured in Home Assistant.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Save an event with start and end for HA automations. Recurrence keeps its duration.

time.name: Time (optional)
time.description: Omit for an all-day event. Seconds must be zero.

monthly_occurrence.name: Occurrence in month
monthly_occurrence.description: Used only by the monthly weekday rule.

anniversary_base.name: Age or anniversary in the starting year

end_date.name: End date (optional)
end_date.description: For all-day events choose the last included day. Empty means same day. Maximum date difference: 366 days.

end_time.name: End time (optional)
end_time.description: Provide both times. End must follow start.

delete_event.name: Delete event
delete_event.description: Delete the entire stored event, including all occurrences of a recurring series.

event_id.name: Event identifier
event_id.description: Use event_id from the Next event entity, or stored_events on the Calendar entity.

refresh_events.name: Fetch events
refresh_events.description: Fetch the device event list without refreshing its physical screen.
